brief:
Filmmaker Yuval Abraham, director of the documentary "Natzá," said the film presents testimonies addressing Israeli military policy of killing civilians as "collateral damage" during targeted assassinations, Shehab Wire reported. Abraham emphasized the importance of examining this policy and its implications.

The documentary features accounts that document how the occupation army's targeted operations resulted in civilian deaths treated as inevitable casualties of the strikes.
